datasets.name: naoj-jupiter-occultations-2019-2020
datasets.source_description: NAOJ (National Astronomical Observatory of Japan) lunar-occultation prediction form; the four Jupiter events of Meeus Table III, 2019 November 28 to 2020 February 19, for a reference site.
datasets.notes: Human-saved result pages, transcribed into a small JSON document. NAOJ renders contact times as a .gif image, so only the machine-readable status text ('Not Visible' / a visible status) is captured; OCR of the image is forbidden. The document is the independent oracle for the Jupiter regression lock in tests/reference_cases/test_meeus_jupiter.py, whose expected values are derived from this repository's own solver and are NOT printed in Meeus.
